',"assets/program-superjs.png":"data:image/webp;base64,",
"assets/program-confidentkidz.png":"data:image/webp;base64,",
"assets/v59-adults.webp":"data:image/webp;base64,"});

// Admin hero photograph is already part of the single-file build; expose it to CSS without another file dependency.
try{document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--v62-admin-hero',`url("${WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS['assets/instructor-master-ogden.png']}")`)}catch(e){}

function v62EventImage(x){
  if(x&&x.image)return x.image;
  const text=((x&&x.title)||'')+' '+((x&&x.category)||'')+' '+((x&&x.region)||'');
  if(/autumn\s*ball/i.test(text))return 'assets/event-autumn-ball.jpg';
  if(/junior\s*(black|award)/i.test(text))return 'assets/event-junior-black.jpg';
  if(/degree|black\s*belt\s*assessment/i.test(text))return 'assets/event-adult-degree.jpg';
  if(/brown.*tag/i.test(text))return 'assets/event-brown-tags.jpg';
  if(/level/i.test(text))return 'assets/event-levels.jpg';
  return 'assets/event-white-to-brown.jpg';
}
window.v62EventImage=v62EventImage;

// Older WJO events are archive content, not disposable data. Merge the original records back into local CMS data
// without overwriting anything the committee has edited or added.
function v62EnsureEventHistory(){
  try{
    const d=cmsData();let changed=false;d.events=Array.isArray(d.events)?d.events:[];
    const byId=new Map(d.events.map(x=>[x.id,x]));
    if(typeof LIVE_EVENTS!=='undefined')LIVE_EVENTS.forEach(seed=>{
      const current=byId.get(seed.id);
      if(!current){d.events.push({...cmsClone(seed),status:'Published',seed:true});changed=true}
      else if(!current.image&&seed.image){current.image=seed.image;changed=true}
    });
    d.gradings=Array.isArray(d.gradings)?d.gradings:[];
    d.gradings.forEach(g=>{if(!g.image){g.image=v62EventImage(g);changed=true}});
    if(changed)cmsSaveData(d);
  }catch(e){console.warn('V62 archive restore',e)}
}
v62EnsureEventHistory();

// Preserve artwork when joining event and grading records.
cmsCombinedEvents=function(){
  const ev=cmsCollection('events').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').map(x=>({...x,image:v62EventImage(x),_type:'events'}));
  const gr=cmsCollection('gradings').filter(x=>!['draft','closed'].includes(String(x.status).toLowerCase())).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.title,category:'Grading • '+(x.region||'WJO'),status:'Published',date:x.date,venue:x.venue,location:x.region||'',desc:x.notes||'',image:v62EventImage(x),_type:'gradings',seed:x.seed}));
  return [...ev,...gr].sort((a,b)=>String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)));
};

cmsEventRow=function(x){
  const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';const d=new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00');
  return `<article class="event-row-v28 v62-event-row${cls}" style="position:relative"><div class="event-date-v28"><div class="day">${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}</div><div><div class="month">${d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</div><div class="weekday">${d.toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'})}</div></div></div><div class="v62-event-thumb"><img src="${resolveAssetPath(v62EventImage(x))}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.title||'WJO event')}"></div><div class="event-body-v28"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO Event')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.desc||'')}</p><span class="venue">${cmsEscape(x.venue||'')} ${x.location?'• '+cmsEscape(x.location):''}</span></div><button class="btn ghost event-detail-button" type="button" onclick="cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')">VIEW DETAILS</button></article>`;
};
window.cmsEventRow=cmsEventRow;

// Events page shows the full retained WJO archive plus current/upcoming records; no date is silently discarded.
routes.events=()=>{
  const items=cmsCombinedEvents();const months=[...new Set(items.filter(e=>e.date).map(e=>e.date.slice(0,7)))];
  return shell(`<main>${pageHero('WHAT’S COMING UP <em>AT WJO.</em>','Events & gradings','WJO event and grading dates, including retained earlier events.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="v62-events-archive-note"><b>Full event history retained.</b><span>Earlier events remain available alongside current and upcoming dates.</span></div><div class="event-view-toolbar"><div class="event-view-switch"><button class="active" type="button" data-view="list" onclick="setEventView('list')">LIST</button><button type="button" data-view="month" onclick="setEventView('month')">MONTH</button></div></div><div id="events-list-pane" class="event-view-pane"><div class="event-list-v28">${items.map(cmsEventRow).join('')}</div></div><div id="events-month-pane" class="event-view-pane" hidden><div class="event-months">${months.map(m=>{const [y,mo]=m.split('-').map(Number);return cmsCalendarMonth(y,mo-1,items)}).join('')}</div></div></div></section></main>`);
};

// Put supplied event artwork back into the two homepage event highlights.
const V62_HOME_BASE=routes.home;
routes.home=function(){
  let html=V62_HOME_BASE();
  html=html.replace(`<button class="v47-event" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('autumn-ball-oct-24')"><div class="v47-event-date"><b>24</b><span>OCT 2026</span></div><div class="v47-event-copy">`,`<button class="v47-event v62-home-event" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('autumn-ball-oct-24')"><div class="v47-event-date"><b>24</b><span>OCT 2026</span></div><div class="v62-home-event-image"><img src="assets/event-autumn-ball.jpg" alt="WJO Autumn Ball 2026"></div><div class="v47-event-copy">`);
  html=html.replace(`<button class="v47-event" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('scotland-oct-26')"><div class="v47-event-date"><b>26</b><span>OCT 2026</span></div><div class="v47-event-copy">`,`<button class="v47-event v62-home-event" type="button" onclick="showEventDetails('scotland-oct-26')"><div class="v47-event-date"><b>26</b><span>OCT 2026</span></div><div class="v62-home-event-image"><img src="assets/event-white-to-brown.jpg" alt="Scotland regional grading"></div><div class="v47-event-copy">`);
  return html;
};

// Mobile admin navigation: when the user chooses an admin management area, land on the workspace rather than the page hero.
let V62_ADMIN_NAV_JUMP=false;
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#admin-"]');if(a&&a.closest('.admin-layout'))V62_ADMIN_NAV_JUMP=true;
},true);
const V62_RENDER_BASE=render;
render=function(){
  const raw=(location.hash||'#home').slice(1);const key=raw.split('?')[0]||'home';
  const result=V62_RENDER_BASE.apply(this,arguments);
  try{
    if(/^admin(?:-|$)/.test(key)){
      const hero=document.querySelector('.page-hero');if(hero)hero.classList.add('v62-admin-hero');
      const workspace=document.querySelector('.admin-main');if(workspace)workspace.id='admin-workspace-v62';
      if(V62_ADMIN_NAV_JUMP&&innerWidth<=980&&workspace){
        V62_ADMIN_NAV_JUMP=false;
        setTimeout(()=>{
          workspace.classList.remove('v62-admin-jump-flash');void workspace.offsetWidth;workspace.classList.add('v62-admin-jump-flash');
          const top=window.scrollY+workspace.getBoundingClientRect().top-10;window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,top),behavior:'smooth'});
          setTimeout(()=>workspace.classList.remove('v62-admin-jump-flash'),1100);
        },90);
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return result;
};

// V62 release identity for exported content backups.
const V62_EXPORT_BASE=typeof cmsExportData==='function'?cmsExportData:null;
if(V62_EXPORT_BASE){cmsExportData=function(){const d=cmsData();const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(d,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v63.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','V62 content was exported as JSON.')};window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData}
